declarations.name: ChatFiles

members.name: absolute
members.doc: A path made absolute and without `..` (a project's root as the chat keeps it).

members.name: append_line
members.doc: Appends one line (it must hold no line break).

members.name: is_folder
members.doc: Whether a folder exists (a project's root).

members.name: move
members.doc: Moves a file to `to` (its folder made), never over one there; false when there was no file.

members.name: read_lines
members.doc: The lines of a file, empty ones left out; none when it does not exist.

members.name: read_text
members.doc: The text of a file, or null when it does not exist.

members.name: scratch_folder
members.doc: A new empty folder in the system's temporary place (a test's project, a scratch).

declarations.doc: The files of a project's chat (spec 013, design.md "On disk"): lines appended to a file, a file read as its lines, a file replaced whole (a temporary file beside it, then renamed, so a crash never lea

declarations.name: ChatPack

members.name: drawing
members.doc: The text of one drawing of the pack (an SVG file named in `pack.json`; never a path out of the pack).

declarations.doc: The GIF pack made for the project (`nuclear-chat/pack/`: animated SVG files and `pack.json`, their tags). It travels inside this package; a checkout reads the project's own. `NUCLEAR_CHAT_PACK` names

members.name: keep
members.doc: Keeps the key of a GIF service.

members.name: key
members.doc: The key of a GIF service, or null when none is kept (or there is no keyring).

members.name: lookup
members.doc: What the keyring keeps for an account, or null; no keyring at all is an error.

members.name: run
members.doc: Runs the keyring's command of this system, found on the PATH.

declarations.name: Processes

members.name: is_running
members.doc: Whether a run is going on.

members.name: start
members.doc: Starts `command` in `cwd` with `input` as its first line; null, or why it could not start.

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stops a run and every process it started (its process group).

members.name: write
members.doc: Writes one line to the stdin of a run going on; false when it ended.

declarations.name: keyring_command
declarations.doc: The commands of each system: store (the key on stdin), lookup (the key on stdout), clear.

declarations.name: keyring_env
declarations.doc: The environment with the user's session bus, where the keyring answers (a service started at login may have a minimal one).
